purpose: Mission-style multihop statistical analysis on the public MCP surface when there is no one-to-one query_sql_source tool.

steps.notes: Verify the source name and key columns.
Resolve the bridge dataset used for delay metrics.
Confirm the bridge keys before building the SQL rowset.
Resolve the third governed dataset used in the bridge path.
Confirm the terminal dataset and join keys.

arguments.sql: select corr(delay.dep_delay_minutes, nps.nps_score) as delay_nps_correlation, count(*) as joined_non_null_rows from nps join delay on delay.flight_id = nps.flight_id join flights on flights.id = delay.flight_id where delay.dep_delay_minutes is not null and nps.nps_score is not null

steps.notes: Use query_sql_report for bridge-table statistical SQL on MCP. There is no one-to-one query_sql_source MCP tool.
